onenight.title: Une nuit
onenight.kicker: One night ashore · pick the quarter you are berthed nearest · walking order
onenight.lede: Piraeus eats late and by the water: a drink as the light goes, the fish chosen off the ice from about nine, the music after ten, and phyllo through the night. Each quarter below is one evening, in the order you walk it. Every name opens its full card; hours were re-checked on 14 October 2026, and where the listings disagree the card says call.
onenight.door_en: Crew ashore for one evening: a plan for each quarter — a glass, the table, the music and the late plate, in walking order.
onenight.door_note: Le verre · la table · la musique · la bougatsa

quarters.name: Mikrolimano and the Kastella slope
quarters.line: A drink over the moorings, the 1932 fish house, rebetiko up the hill.

steps.name: Istioploikos
steps.text: The two-level deck at the tip of the crescent, the sailboats right under the rail: one drink as the harbour lights come on.

steps.name: Dourabeis
steps.text: Round the quay to Akti Dilaveri. Choose the fish off the ice, ask the price per kilo before it is weighed, and have it salt-grilled. About EUR 75–100 a head by FNL 2026: book.

steps.name: Kafeniote
steps.text: Ten minutes up the slope to the wood-panelled kafeneio, open to about two at the weekend and closed Monday and Tuesday by its last listing; the live rembetika is on Sunday night. Ring first.

quarters.after: Cheaper: the Constantinople kitchen at [[venue:vosporos|Vosporos]] on the same quay, open daily to one in the morning by its own site. Spend more: Lefteris Lazarou's [[venue:varoulko-seaside|Varoulko Seaside]] (the listings disagree on a Monday close: call).

quarters.name: The Piraiki and Hatzikyriakio
quarters.line: The sea-wall at sundown, a captain's eight tables, a cocktail with the windows open.

steps.name: The Piraiki coast walk
steps.ref: card:The Piraiki coast walk to the lighthouse
steps.text: Along Akti Themistokleous with the ancient wall blocks at the waterline, facing west into the last light; flat, an hour or so.

steps.name: To Yperokeaneion
steps.text: Eight tables in a former nautical warehouse on Marias Chatzikyriakou, anchors and liner relics on the walls; fish and the ladenia of Kimolos. Too small to walk in: book, and confirm the hours when you do.

steps.name: The Art of Bragi
steps.text: Back along the coast road to the small cocktail room at Akti Themistokleous 154; not re-confirmed this autumn, so check it is open.

quarters.after: Cheaper, and earlier: [[venue:margaro|Margaro]] by the Naval Academy, no menu and no bookings, fried fish to midnight Monday and Wednesday to Saturday, closed Tuesday (by its record; not re-confirmed this autumn).

quarters.name: Pasalimani and Freattyda
quarters.line: Oysters on the marina deck, the producer-built meze house, the rock bar after midnight.

steps.name: Hams & Clams
steps.text: French oysters opened to order and a natural glass on the Zea deck as the marina lights come on.

steps.name: Dyosmos
steps.text: A short walk to Freattydos 42A and the 1920 neoclassical house: Cretan staka pasta, island fava, a tsipouro. Listings give weekdays from 18:00 to 01:00: not re-confirmed this autumn, so ring.

steps.name: Amsterdam Bar
steps.text: Back to the marina pavement and the bicycle-saddle stools; the card has it open to the small hours at the weekend (seen July 2026).

quarters.name: The port centre and Agios Dionysios
quarters.line: The roof level with the ferries, barrel retsina, a room that dances.

steps.name: 801 Rooftop Bar
steps.text: Eight floors up opposite Gate E7, level with the night ferries. Seasonal: late April to October, so October is its last month.

steps.name: To Eidikon
steps.text: Ten minutes behind the port to Psaron 38: retsina drawn from the barrels under the floor and five or six mezedes. Its days vary and it was not re-confirmed this autumn: call.

steps.name: Stou Thoma
steps.text: A taxi or a long walk to Mavromichali 22, where the regulars get up to dance the zeibekiko; Wednesday to Saturday from about ten (seen July 2026).

quarters.after: Instead of the barrels: the stone wine-house of 1896 at [[venue:propolemikon|Propolemikon]], rebetika on Saturday night by its record (call).

quarters.name: Drapetsona, by taxi
quarters.line: The oldest taverna of the refugee quarter, then the kompania where the tekedes stood.

steps.name: Taverna tou Katsogiannou
steps.text: Opposite Agios Panteleimon: about six pots of the day and hand-cut fries. By its own site, Tuesday to Thursday to 22:30, Friday and Saturday to 23:00, Sunday lunch only, closed Monday.

steps.name: Revaizi
steps.text: A short taxi to Thermopylon 28 for the live kompania, Friday to Sunday (seen July 2026): ring to check who is playing.

quarters.after: Earlier, by the water: [[venue:to-limanaki-tou-giorgou|To Limanaki tou Giorgou]] on the Keratsini harbour, under the dead power station; call, weekends fill.

quarters.name: Nikaia and Kokkinia, by taxi
quarters.line: Smyrna at the table, then bougatsa from the 24-hour ovens.

steps.name: Alargino
steps.text: The 1938 building on Agiou Ioannou: Smyrna soutzoukakia and pastourma pie, live strings on Saturday. One listing gives Friday and Saturday 15:00–02:00; book on music nights.

steps.name: Bougatsa Pavlidi
steps.text: Taxi to Petrou Ralli 168 for sweet bougatsa off the tray; To Vima (March 2026) says it runs round the clock, one listing shows Wednesday closed.

quarters.after: Instead: the fig-tree yard at [[venue:to-koutouki-tou-antoni|To Koutouki tou Antoni]] in Palaia Kokkinia, Tuesday to Saturday to midnight by its record (not re-confirmed this autumn).

getaway.title: Le week-end
getaway.door_en: Friday night to Sunday afternoon: the crescent at dusk, the market at eight, four bronzes from a drain, the fry with no menu, the sea-wall at sundown and Sunday lunch in Drapetsona.
getaway.door_note: Le port · le marché · la mer · la table
getaway.kicker: The getaway weekend · Friday night to Sunday afternoon
getaway.lede: Piraeus sells itself as a ferry gate and a terrace of photo-menus on Mikrolimano. The real weekend is the fish you choose off the ice yourself, the market streets at eight, the bronzes in the museum, a fry with no menu, the west-facing sea-wall at sundown and a Sunday lunch in the quarter the refugees of 1922 built. Every stop below is already in this guide and was re-checked on 14 October 2026; where a place could not be re-confirmed, the stop says ring. This reading puts them in order, and tells you what to book before you fly.
book: [[venue:dourabeis|Dourabeis]] — for Friday dinner; ask for a table at the window over the harbour.
[[venue:to-yperokeaneion|To Yperokeaneion]] — for Saturday dinner; eight tables, so book early and confirm the hours.
[[venue:taverna-tou-katsogiannou|Taverna tou Katsogiannou]] — for Sunday lunch, 13:00–17:00 by its own site.

stops.name: A drink over the moorings at Istioploikos
stops.text: The deck at the tip of Mikrolimano, the sailboats under the rail. One drink, then walk the quay past the hosts without stopping.
stops.meta: Tip of the Mikrolimano quay · not re-confirmed this autumn

stops.name: Dinner at Dourabeis
stops.text: The family fish house of 1932 below Kastella. Pick the fish off the ice, hear the price per kilo before it is weighed, and order the shrimp saganaki the harbour invented.
stops.meta: Akti Dilaveri 29 · about EUR 75–100 a head (FNL 2026) · book

stops.name: Up the slope to Kafeniote
stops.text: The wood-panelled evening kafeneio on the way up to Kastella, for a raki and the end of the night.
stops.meta: Fri–Sun to about 02:00 by its last listing (seen Jul 2026) · ring

days.label: Saturday
days.title: The market, the bronzes and the sea-wall

stops.name: Piroski at Euxeinon
stops.text: The Pontic fried pies, cheese or mince, from a dough started at three in the morning; on Saturdays there is peinirli with pastourma. Gone by midday.
stops.meta: Navarchou Notara 50 · a couple of euros each · not re-confirmed this autumn

stops.name: The market streets
stops.text: The shed is half empty; the streets round it are the market. Briki coffee among the porters at [[card:O Stavros|O Stavros]], pastourma at [[card:Avakian|Avakian]], the spice sacks at [[card:Mandragoras|Mandragoras]].
stops.meta: Mornings to mid-afternoon · most shops closed Sunday · cash

stops.name: The Archaeological Museum of Piraeus
stops.text: Four Classical bronzes in one room, found in 1959 by workmen digging a sewer. Then down to Zea for the trireme slipways through a basement window at [[card:Zea Shipsheds (ancient neosoikoi)|the shipsheds]].
stops.meta: Charilaou Trikoupi 31 · EUR 10 · Wed–Mon 09:00–17:00 to 31 Oct, closed Tue; check winter hours from 1 Nov

stops.name: Lunch at Margaro
stops.text: By the Naval Academy: no menu, a grandchild recites what the boats brought, the fry and the family retsina. No bookings, so expect a short queue.
stops.meta: Chatzikyriakou 126 · Sat 12:00–24:00 by its record, closed Tue · not re-confirmed this autumn

stops.name: The Piraiki at sundown
stops.ref: card:The Piraiki coast walk to the lighthouse
stops.text: The west-facing coast road with the ancient wall blocks in the water, past the flat rocks and the seamen's cross at [[card:Ormos Afroditis (Aphrodite Cove) rocks|Aphrodite Cove]] as the gulf goes copper.
stops.meta: Start at Freattyda · flat · about an hour

stops.name: Dinner at To Yperokeaneion
stops.text: A Kimolos captain's eight tables among anchors and liner relics: grilled sardines, the ladenia of his island, an ouzo.
stops.meta: Marias Chatzikyriakou 48 · book · confirm the hours when you do

stops.name: Rebetiko at Stou Thoma
stops.text: A taxi to the room where the regulars, not a tour group, get up to dance. Acoustic means the right room.
stops.meta: Mavromichali 22–24 · Wed–Sat from about 22:00 (seen Jul 2026) · ring

days.label: Sunday
days.title: The hill, and lunch in Drapetsona

stops.name: Galaktoboureko at Mastronikolas
stops.text: The custard pie the port measures against, from a family that began with a milk round by donkey in 1909. A counter, not a café: take it with you.
stops.meta: Karaoli & Dimitriou 68 · Sun from 09:00 by its record · not re-confirmed this autumn

stops.name: Round the crescent and up the stairs
stops.text: The fishing harbour in the morning, then the stairways of Kastella to the crown of the hill and the whole gulf below.
stops.meta: Start on the Mikrolimano quay · stairs · two to three kilometres

stops.name: Sunday lunch at Taverna tou Katsogiannou
stops.text: A taxi to Drapetsona and the oldest taverna in the quarter: the pots of the day, the ouzo meatballs, the hand-cut fries, a 1930 refrigerator still running.
stops.meta: Agiou Panteleimonos 15 · Sun 13:00–17:00 by its own site · book

more.title: If you have only one evening
more.text: A drink on the deck at [[card:Istioploikos|Istioploikos]], dinner at [[venue:dourabeis|Dourabeis]], and bougatsa in the small hours at [[venue:bougatsa-pavlidi|Bougatsa Pavlidi]] in Nikaia. That is the port in one night.

more.title: The grand night instead
more.text: Swap Saturday's dinner for [[venue:varoulko-seaside|Varoulko Seaside]], Lefteris Lazarou's room on the marina: Athinorama put it at the top of its Greek cuisine awards in May 2026, but it has held no MICHELIN star since the 2024 selection. The 2026/27 Greece selection is due on 20 October 2026. Or [[venue:papaioannou|Papaioannou]] on the same quay, for the plainest grilled fish on the crescent.

more.title: Or the island instead of the museum
more.text: Take Saturday on the water: [[card:Aegina|Aegina]] is about forty minutes by fast boat, for the pistachio orchards and the temple of Aphaia on its pine hill. Check the gate and the last boat back before you go.

more.title: This October and November
items: The trawlers are back since 1 October: the wild bottom fish has returned to the [[card:Ichthyoskala Keratsiniou|Keratsini auction]] and the ice, and palamida is at its peak.
Clocks go back an hour in the early hours of Sunday 25 October.
Ohi Day is Wednesday 28 October: parades in the morning and a public holiday.
The Athens Marathon is Sunday 8 November: roads in the city close for the morning, so move any airport transfer to the afternoon.
The [[card:801 Rooftop Bar|801 Rooftop]] closes for the season at the end of October.

more.title: Where to sleep
more.text: This guide does not judge hotels. The weekend is built to be walked from Mikrolimano, Pasalimani or the port centre. The only hotel in it is one we send you to for a drink, the Mitsis N'U Piraeus Port opposite Gate E7, home of the [[card:801 Rooftop Bar|801 Rooftop]]: we have not judged its rooms.

more.title: What we would leave out
more.text: A full dinner on the front-row Mikrolimano terraces, where a host waves a photo-menu and the fish is weighed out of sight. A round-number taxi fare at the ferry gate with the meter dark. A staged rebetiko show with electric bouzouki that has you home by eleven. And the fish auction as a sight: it is a working floor in the dark, hosed down by mid-morning.
